subject: [PATCH v2 1/3] mm: vmscan: allow writeout of swapcache folios without anon mappings

2026-11-10.patch_summary: This patch allows the writeout of swapcache folios without anonymous mappings, enabling reclaim to write out dirty pages in swapcache even if they don't have an anonymous mapping. This is necessary because pageout() previously rejected these pages before they could be written out using the existing swap writeout path. The change affects how the filesystem checks for valid mappings and allows swapcache folios to bypass certain checks.
